payload.purpose_context: Make the toy arcade tactile and expressive by synchronising sound cues with existing animations and speech bubbles. Use the downloaded open audio collections, respect mute and reduced motion, and keep music outside this mission.
payload.purpose_tldr: Integrate downloaded sound effects with machine movement, ball interactions and character speech.

payload.question: Confirm scope: select and integrate downloaded SFX for character speech, coin insertion, claw movement and grip/release, chute drop, ball rolling, rack arrival and overflow ejection, plus Coinie footsteps/jump/smoke and UI clicks; synchronise cues with animations, support mute and reduced motion, update attribution records, and exclude music. Capsule reveal/discard sounds apply only if those interactions exist at implementation time.
